title: The Four-Day School Week
topic: การศึกษา (ข้อมูล/ผลสำรวจ)
lines: A growing number of schools in the United States have moved to a four-day
week. In 2010 there were about 120 **such** schools; today there are more
than 900, most of them in small rural towns. Students attend longer days
from Monday to Thursday and have Fridays off.
The main reason is money. Rural schools often struggle to find teachers,
and a shorter week saves on buses, heating and electricity. **It** also helps
attract teachers, many of **whom** say a three-day weekend is worth more to
But the results for students are mixed. One large study found that
test scores fell slightly in schools that switched, especially in math.
**Others** found no clear difference. Working parents face another problem:
**they** must find childcare on Fridays, which can be expensive.
Supporters argue that the extra day can be used for sports, part-time jobs
or extra classes. Critics say **this** only works for families that can
afford it, and that the poorest students may fall further behind.
